      <description>&lt;h3 id=&#34;features&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Features&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;ol&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Lifecycle management of App Mesh&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Lifecycle management of sample applications&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Performance testing&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ol&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;sample-applications&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Sample Applications&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#emojivoto&#34;&gt;Emojivoto&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;A microservice application that allows users to vote for their favorite emoji, and tracks votes received on a leaderboard.&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#bookinfo&#34;&gt;Bookinfo&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#httpbin&#34;&gt;Httpbin&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Httpbin is a simple HTTP request and response service.&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;performance-management&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Performance Management&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Identify overhead involved in running the App Mesh, various App Mesh configurations while running different workloads and on different infrastructure. The adapter facilitates data plane and control plane performance testing.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Meshery Adapter for Cilium Service Mesh</title>
      <link>/v0.9/extensions/adapters/cilium/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/extensions/adapters/cilium/</guid>
      <description>&lt;p&gt;The Meshery Adapter for Cilium Service Mesh is currently under construction (stable state), which means that the adapter is not functional and cannot be interacted with through the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/installation#6-you-will-now-be-directed-to-the-meshery-ui&#34;&gt; Meshery UI &lt;/a&gt;at the moment. Check back here to see updates.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Want to contribute? Check our &lt;a href=&#34;https://github.com/meshery/meshery-cilium&#34;&gt;progress&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Meshery Adapter for Consul</title>
      <link>/v0.9/extensions/adapters/consul/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/extensions/adapters/consul/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h3 id=&#34;features&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Features&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;ol&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Lifecycle management of Consul&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Lifecycle management of sample applications&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Performance management of Consul and it workloads&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Prometheus and Grafana integration&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Configuration management and best practices of Consul&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Custom configuration&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ol&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;sample-applications&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Sample Applications&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Meshery supports the deployment of a variety of sample applications on Meshery Adapter for Consul. Use Meshery to deploy any of these sample applications.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#httpbin&#34;&gt;httpbin&lt;/a&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Httpbin is a simple HTTP request and response service.&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#bookinfo&#34;&gt;Bookinfo&lt;/a&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;The sample BookInfo application displays information about a book, similar to a single catalog entry of an online book store.&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#imagehub&#34;&gt;Image Hub&lt;/a&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Image Hub is a sample application written to run on Consul for exploring WebAssembly modules used as Envoy filters.&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;performance-management-of-consul-and-it-workloads&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Performance management of Consul and it workloads&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;h4 id=&#34;prometheus-and-grafana-integration&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Prometheus and Grafana integration&#xA;&lt;/h4&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;The Meshery Adapter for Consul will connect to Meshery Adapter for Consul&amp;rsquo;s Prometheus and Grafana instances running in the control plane (typically found in a separate namespace) or other instances to which Meshery has network reachability.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Meshery Adapter for Istio</title>
      <link>/v0.9/extensions/adapters/istio/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/extensions/adapters/istio/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h2 id=&#34;features&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Features&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;ol&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Istio Lifecycle Management&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Workload Lifecycle Management&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Cloud Native Performance (SMP)&#xA;&lt;ol&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Prometheus and Grafana connections&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ol&gt;&#xA;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Configuration Analysis, Patterns, and Best Practices&#xA;&lt;ol&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Custom Configuration&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ol&gt;&#xA;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ol&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;workload-management&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Workload Management&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;The Meshery Adapter for Istio includes a handful of sample applications. Use Meshery to deploy any of these sample applications:&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#bookinfo&#34;&gt;Bookinfo&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#httpbin&#34;&gt;Httpbin&lt;/a&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Httpbin is a simple HTTP request and response service.&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#online-boutique&#34;&gt;Online Boutique&lt;/a&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Online Boutique Application is a web-based, e-commerce demo application from the Google Cloud Platform.&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#imagehub&#34;&gt;Image Hub&lt;/a&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Image Hub is a sample application written to run on Consul for exploring WebAssembly modules used as Envoy filters.&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;using-cloud-native-standards&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Using Cloud Native Standards&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Meshery&amp;rsquo;s powerful performance management functionality is accomplished through implementation of &lt;a href=&#34;https://smp-spec.io&#34;&gt;Cloud Native Performance&lt;/a&gt;. Meshery enables operators to deploy WebAssembly filters to Envoy-based data planes. Meshery facilitates learning about functionality and performance of infrastructure and workloads and incorporates the collection and display of metrics from applications using Prometheus and Grafana integrations.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Meshery Adapter for Kuma</title>
      <link>/v0.9/extensions/adapters/kuma/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/extensions/adapters/kuma/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h2 id=&#34;workload-management&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Workload Management&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;The following sample applications are available in this adapter.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#bookinfo&#34;&gt;Bookinfo&lt;/a&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;The sample BookInfo application displays information about a book, similar to a single catalog entry of an online book store.&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Meshery Adapter for Linkerd</title>

      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/extensions/adapters/linkerd/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h3 id=&#34;features&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Features&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;ol&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Lifecycle management of Linkerd&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Lifecycle management of sample applications&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;Performance testing&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ol&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;sample-applications&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Sample Applications&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;The Meshery Adapter for Linkerd includes the ability to deploy a variety of sample applications. Use Meshery to deploy any of these sample applications:&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/&#34;&gt;Emojivoto&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;A microservice application that allows users to vote for their favorite emoji, and tracks votes received on a leaderboard.&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/&#34;&gt;Bookinfo&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;The sample BookInfo application displays information about a book, similar to a single catalog entry of an online book store.&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/&#34;&gt;Linkerd Books&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Meshery Adapter for Network Service Mesh</title>
      <link>/v0.9/extensions/adapters/nsm/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/extensions/adapters/nsm/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h2 id=&#34;sample-applications&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Sample Applications&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;The Meshery Adapter for Network Service Mesh includes a handful of sample applications. These applications represent different network services orchestrated by Network Service Mesh. Use Meshery to deploy any of these sample applications:&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;1-hello-nsm-application&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;1. Hello NSM Application&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Watch this presentation to see the Hello NSM Application in-action:&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;iframe width=&#34;560&#34; height=&#34;315&#34; src=&#34;https://www.youtube.com/embed/4xKixsDTtdM&#34; frameborder=&#34;0&#34; allow=&#34;accelerometer; autoplay; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture&#34; allowfullscreen&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;See on YouTube: &lt;a href=&#34;https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4xKixsDTtdM&amp;amp;list=PL3A-A6hPO2IOpTbdH89qR-4AE0ON13Zie&#34;&gt;Adopting Network Service Mesh with Meshery&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h4 id=&#34;2-vpp-icmp-application&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;2. VPP-ICMP Application&#xA;&lt;/h4&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;A simple example that connects a vpp based Pod to a Network Service using memif.&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>

            <h1>Meshery Adapter for Istio</h1>
          
          
<article>
<table style="display: flex; align-self: center; justify-self: center">
  <th>Cloud Native Infrastructure</th>
  <th>Adapter Status</th>
  <th>Adapter Version</th>
  <th>Earliest Supported Infrastructure Version</th>
  <tr>
    <td><img src="/extensions/adapters/istio/images/istio.svg" style="width:20px" data-logo-for-dark="/extensions/adapters/istio/images/istio-white.svg" data-logo-for-light="/extensions/adapters/istio/images/istio.svg" class="logo-dark-light" loading="lazy"/> Istio</td>
    <td><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery-istio">stable</a></td>
    <td>v0.8.3</td>
    <td>v1.6.0</td>
  </tr>
</table>

  <h2 id="features">
	Features
</h2>
<ol>
<li>Istio Lifecycle Management</li>
<li>Workload Lifecycle Management</li>
<li>Cloud Native Performance (SMP)
<ol>
<li>Prometheus and Grafana connections</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>Configuration Analysis, Patterns, and Best Practices
<ol>
<li>Custom Configuration</li>
</ol>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="workload-management">
	Workload Management
</h3>
<p>The Meshery Adapter for Istio includes a handful of sample applications. Use Meshery to deploy any of these sample applications:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#bookinfo">Bookinfo</a></li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#httpbin">Httpbin</a>
<ul>
<li>Httpbin is a simple HTTP request and response service.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#online-boutique">Online Boutique</a>
<ul>
<li>Online Boutique Application is a web-based, e-commerce demo application from the Google Cloud Platform.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#imagehub">Image Hub</a>
<ul>
<li>Image Hub is a sample application written to run on Consul for exploring WebAssembly modules used as Envoy filters.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="using-cloud-native-standards">
	Using Cloud Native Standards
</h2>
<p>Meshery&rsquo;s powerful performance management functionality is accomplished through implementation of <a href="https://smp-spec.io">Cloud Native Performance</a>. Meshery enables operators to deploy WebAssembly filters to Envoy-based data planes. Meshery facilitates learning about functionality and performance of infrastructure and workloads and incorporates the collection and display of metrics from applications using Prometheus and Grafana integrations.</p>
<h3 id="design-patterns-and-meshery-models">
	Design Patterns and Meshery Models
</h3>
<h3 id="prometheus-and-grafana-connections">
	Prometheus and Grafana connections
</h3>
<p>The Meshery Adapter for Istio allows you to quickly deploy (or remove) an Istio add-ons. Meshery will deploy the Prometheus and Grafana add-ons (including Jaeger and Kiali) into Istio&rsquo;s control plane (typically the <code>istio-system</code> namespace). You can also connect Meshery to Prometheus, Grafana instances not running in the control plane.</p>
<p>If you already have existing Prometheus or Grafana deployments in your cluster, MeshSync will discover them and attempt to automatically register them for use.</p>
<h2 id="configuration-management">
	Configuration Management
</h2>
<p>Meshery Adapter for Istio provides</p>
<h3 id="configuration-best-practices">
	Configuration best practices
</h3>
<p>On demand, the Meshery Adapter for Istio will parse all of Istio&rsquo;s configuration and compare the running configuration of the infrastructure against known best practices for an Meshery Adapter for Istio deployment.</p>
<h3 id="custom-infrastructure-configuration">
	Custom infrastructure configuration
</h3>
<p>Meshery allows you to apply configuration to your infrastructure deployment. You can paste (or type in) any Kubernetes manifest that you would like to have applied to your infrastructure, in fact, you can apply any configuration that you would like to your Kubernetes cluster. This configuration may be VirtualServices, DestinationRules or any other custom Istio resource.</p>
<a href="/extensions/adapters/istio/images/istio-adapter-custom-configuration.png">
  <img style="width:500px;" src="/extensions/adapters/istio/images/istio-adapter-custom-configuration.png" />
</a>
<p>Add-on resources can be applied <strong>or</strong> deleted using this custom configuration operation.</p>
<h3 id="suggested-topics">
	Suggested Topics
</h3>
<ul>
<li>Examine <a href="/architecture">Meshery&rsquo;s architecture</a> and how adapters fit in as a component.</li>
<li>Learn more about <a href="/architecture/adapters">Meshery Adapters</a>.</li>
</ul>
  
  






<h3>Lifecycle management</h3>

<p>The Meshery Adapter for Istio can install <strong>v1.6.0</strong> of Istio. A number of sample applications can be installed using the Meshery Adapter for Istio.</p>











    <h3>Install Istio</h3>
    <p>In Meshery's UI, choose the Meshery Adapter for Istio.</p>
  <a href="/extensions/adapters/istio/images/istio-adapter.png">
    <img style="width:500px;" src="/extensions/adapters/istio/images/istio-adapter.png" />
  </a>

  <p>Click on (+) and choose the <strong>v1.6.0</strong> of the Istio.</p>

  <a href="/extensions/adapters/istio/images/istio-install.png">
    <img style="width:500px;" src="/extensions/adapters/istio/images/istio-install.png" />
  </a>


</article>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Meshery Adapter for Kuma</h1>
          
          
<article>
<table style="display: flex; align-self: center; justify-self: center">
  <th>Cloud Native Infrastructure</th>
  <th>Adapter Status</th>
  <th>Adapter Version</th>
  <th>Earliest Supported Infrastructure Version</th>
  <tr>
    <td><img src="/extensions/adapters/kuma/images/kuma.svg" style="width:20px" data-logo-for-dark="/extensions/adapters/kuma/images/kuma-white.svg" data-logo-for-light="/extensions/adapters/kuma/images/kuma.svg" class="logo-dark-light" loading="lazy"/> Kuma</td>
    <td><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery-kuma">stable</a></td>
    <td>v0.8.1</td>
    <td>v1.2.2</td>
  </tr>
</table>

  <h2 id="workload-management">
	Workload Management
</h2>
<p>The following sample applications are available in this adapter.</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/#bookinfo">Bookinfo</a>
<ul>
<li>The sample BookInfo application displays information about a book, similar to a single catalog entry of an online book store.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
  
  






<h3>Lifecycle management</h3>

<p>The Meshery Adapter for Kuma can install <strong>v1.2.2</strong> of Kuma. A number of sample applications can be installed using the Meshery Adapter for Kuma.</p>











    <h3>Install Kuma</h3>
    <p>In Meshery's UI, choose the Meshery Adapter for Kuma.</p>
  <a href="/extensions/adapters/kuma/images/kuma-adapter.png">
    <img style="width:500px;" src="/extensions/adapters/kuma/images/kuma-adapter.png" />
  </a>

  <p>Click on (+) and choose the <strong>v1.2.2</strong> of the Kuma.</p>

  <a href="/extensions/adapters/kuma/images/kuma-install.png">
    <img style="width:500px;" src="/extensions/adapters/kuma/images/kuma-install.png" />
  </a>


</article>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Meshery Adapter for Linkerd</h1>
          
          
<article>
<table style="display: flex; align-self: center; justify-self: center">
  <th>Cloud Native Infrastructure</th>
  <th>Adapter Status</th>
  <th>Adapter Version</th>
  <th>Earliest Supported Infrastructure Version</th>
  <tr>
    <td><img src="/extensions/adapters/linkerd/images/linkerd.svg" style="width:20px" data-logo-for-dark="/extensions/adapters/linkerd/images/linkerd-white.svg" data-logo-for-light="/extensions/adapters/linkerd/images/linkerd.svg" class="logo-dark-light" loading="lazy"/> Linkerd</td>
    <td><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery-linkerd">stable</a></td>
    <td>v0.8.2</td>
    <td>v2.10.2</td>
  </tr>
</table>

  <h3 id="features">
	Features
</h3>
<ol>
<li>Lifecycle management of Linkerd</li>
<li>Lifecycle management of sample applications</li>
<li>Performance testing</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="sample-applications">
	Sample Applications
</h3>
<p>The Meshery Adapter for Linkerd includes the ability to deploy a variety of sample applications. Use Meshery to deploy any of these sample applications:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/">Emojivoto</a></p>
<ul>
<li>A microservice application that allows users to vote for their favorite emoji, and tracks votes received on a leaderboard.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/">Bookinfo</a></p>
<ul>
<li>The sample BookInfo application displays information about a book, similar to a single catalog entry of an online book store.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/">Linkerd Books</a></p>
<ul>
<li>A sample application built for demonstrating manage your bookshelf.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/">HTTPbin</a></p>
<ul>
<li>A simple HTTP Request &amp; Response Service.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Identify overhead involved in running Linkerd, various Linkerd configurations while running different workloads and on different infrastructure. The adapter facilitates data plane and control plane performance testing.</p>
<ol>
<li>Prometheus integration</li>
<li>Grafana integration</li>
</ol>
<p>The <a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery-linkerd">Meshery Adapter for Linkerd</a> will connect to Linkerd&rsquo;s Prometheus and Grafana instances running in the control plane.</p>
  
  






<h3>Lifecycle management</h3>

<p>The Meshery Adapter for Linkerd can install <strong>v2.10.2</strong> of Linkerd. A number of sample applications can be installed using the Meshery Adapter for Linkerd.</p>











    <h3>Install Linkerd</h3>
    <p>In Meshery's UI, choose the Meshery Adapter for Linkerd.</p>
  <a href="/extensions/adapters/linkerd/images/linkerd-adapter.png">
    <img style="width:500px;" src="/extensions/adapters/linkerd/images/linkerd-adapter.png" />
  </a>

  <p>Click on (+) and choose the <strong>v2.10.2</strong> of the Linkerd.</p>

  <a href="/extensions/adapters/linkerd/images/linkerd-install.png">
    <img style="width:500px;" src="/extensions/adapters/linkerd/images/linkerd-install.png" />
  </a>


</article>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Meshery Adapter for NGINX Service Mesh</h1>
          
          
<article>
<table style="display: flex; align-self: center; justify-self: center">
  <th>Cloud Native Infrastructure</th>
  <th>Adapter Status</th>
  <th>Adapter Version</th>
  <th>Earliest Supported Infrastructure Version</th>
  <tr>
    <td><img src="/extensions/adapters/nginx-sm/images/nginx-sm.svg" style="width:20px" data-logo-for-dark="/extensions/adapters/nginx-sm/images/nginx-sm-white.svg" data-logo-for-light="/extensions/adapters/nginx-sm/images/nginx-sm.svg" class="logo-dark-light" loading="lazy"/> NGINX Service Mesh</td>
    <td><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery-nginx-sm">stable</a></td>
    <td>v0.8.1</td>
    <td>v1.2.0</td>
  </tr>
</table>

  <p>The Meshery Adapter for NGINX Service Mesh is currently under construction (stable state). Want to contribute? Check our <a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery-nginx-sm">progress</a>.</p>
<h3 id="features">
	Features
</h3>
<ol>
<li>Lifecycle management of NGINX Service Mesh</li>
<li>Lifecycle management of sample applications</li>
<li>Performance testing</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="sample-applications">
	Sample Applications
</h3>
<p>The Meshery Adapter for NGINX Service Mesh includes a handful of sample applications. Use Meshery to deploy any of these sample applications.</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/">Emojivoto</a></p>
<ul>
<li>A microservice application that allows users to vote for their favorite emoji, and tracks votes received on a leaderboard.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/">Bookinfo</a></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/">Httpbin</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Httpbin is a simple HTTP request and response service.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/BuoyantIO/booksapp">NGINX Books</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Application that helps you manage your bookshelf.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Identify overhead involved in running NGINX Service Mesh, various NGINX Service Mesh configurations while running different workloads and on different infrastructure. The adapter facilitates data plane and control plane performance testing.</p>
<ol>
<li>Prometheus integration</li>
<li>Grafana integration</li>
</ol>
  
  






<h3>Lifecycle management</h3>

<p>The Meshery Adapter for NGINX Service Mesh can install <strong>v1.2.0</strong> of NGINX Service Mesh. A number of sample applications can be installed using the Meshery Adapter for NGINX Service Mesh.</p>












</article>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Meshery Adapter for Network Service Mesh</h1>
          
          
<article>
<table style="display: flex; align-self: center; justify-self: center">
  <th>Cloud Native Infrastructure</th>
  <th>Adapter Status</th>
  <th>Adapter Version</th>
  <th>Earliest Supported Infrastructure Version</th>
  <tr>
    <td><img src="/extensions/adapters/nsm/images/nsm.svg" style="width:20px" data-logo-for-dark="/extensions/adapters/nsm/images/nsm.svg" data-logo-for-light="/extensions/adapters/nsm/images/nsm.svg" class="logo-dark-light" loading="lazy"/> Network Service Mesh</td>
    <td><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery-nsm">stable</a></td>
    <td>v0.5.4</td>
    <td>v0.2.1</td>
  </tr>
</table>

  <h2 id="sample-applications">
	Sample Applications
</h2>
<p>The Meshery Adapter for Network Service Mesh includes a handful of sample applications. These applications represent different network services orchestrated by Network Service Mesh. Use Meshery to deploy any of these sample applications:</p>
<h3 id="1-hello-nsm-application">
	1. Hello NSM Application
</h3>
<p>Watch this presentation to see the Hello NSM Application in-action:</p>
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/4xKixsDTtdM" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>
<p>See on YouTube: <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4xKixsDTtdM&amp;list=PL3A-A6hPO2IOpTbdH89qR-4AE0ON13Zie">Adopting Network Service Mesh with Meshery</a></p>
<h4 id="2-vpp-icmp-application">
	2. VPP-ICMP Application
</h4>
<p><em>A simple example that connects a vpp based Pod to a Network Service using memif.</em></p>
<p>The simplest possible case for Network Service Mesh is to have is connecting a Client via a vWire to another Pod that is providing a Network Service.
Network Service Mesh allows flexibility in the choice of mechanisms used to provide that vWire to a workload.</p>
<p>The icmp responder example does this with kernel interfaces. The vpp-icmp-responder provides and consumes the same &lsquo;icmp-responder&rsquo; Network Service, but has Client&rsquo;s and Endpoint&rsquo;s that use a <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6aVr32WgY0Q">memif</a> high speed memory interfaces to achieve performance unavailable via kernel interfaces.</p>
<a href="/extensions/adapters/nsm/images/vpp-icmp-responder-example.svg">
  <img style="width:500px; background: white" src="/extensions/adapters/nsm/images/vpp-icmp-responder-example.svg" />
</a>
<p>Working process</p>
<p>This will install two Deployments:</p>
<table>
  <thead>
      <tr>
          <th style="text-align: left">Name</th>
          <th style="text-align: left">Description</th>
      </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
      <tr>
          <td style="text-align: left">vpp-icmp-responder-nsc</td>
          <td style="text-align: left">The Clients (four replicas)</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td style="text-align: left">vpp-icmp-responder-nse</td>
          <td style="text-align: left">The Endpoints (two replicas)</td>
      </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
<p>And cause each Client to get a vWire connecting it to one of the Endpoints. Network Service Mesh handles the Network Service Discovery and Routing, as well as the vWire &lsquo;Connection Handling&rsquo; for setting all of this up.</p>
<a href="/extensions/adapters/nsm/images/vpp-icmp-responder-example-2.svg">
  <img style="width:500px; background: white" src="/extensions/adapters/nsm/images/vpp-icmp-responder-example-2.svg" />
</a>
<p>In order to make this case more interesting, Endpoint1 and Endpoint2 are deployed on two separate Nodes using PodAntiAffinity, so that the Network Service Mesh has to demonstrate the ability to string vWires between Clients and Endpoints on the same Node and Clients and Endpoints on different Nodes.</p>
<p>Verification</p>
<p>First verify that the vpp-icmp-responder example Pods are all up and running:</p>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock"><div class="clipboardjs">
 $ kubectl get pods | grep vpp-icmp-responder
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<p>To see the vpp-icmp-responder example in action, you can run:</p>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock"><div class="clipboardjs">
 $ curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/networkservicemesh/networkservicemesh/master/scripts/nsc_ping_all.sh | bash
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<h4 id="3-icmp-responder">
	3. ICMP Responder
</h4>
<p>The simplest possible case for Network Service Mesh is to have is connecting a Client via a vWire to another Pod that is providing a Network Service. We call this case the ‘icmp-responder’ example, because it allows the client to ping the IP address of the Endpoint over the vWire.</p>
<a href="/extensions/adapters/nsm/images/icmp-responder-example.svg">
  <img style="width:500px; background: white" src="/extensions/adapters/nsm/images/icmp-responder-example.svg" />
</a>
<p>Outcomes</p>
<p>This will install two Deployments:</p>
<table>
  <thead>
      <tr>
          <th style="text-align: left">Name</th>
          <th style="text-align: left">Description</th>
      </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
      <tr>
          <td style="text-align: left">icmp-responder-nsc</td>
          <td style="text-align: left">The Clients, four replicas</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td style="text-align: left">icmp-responder-nse</td>
          <td style="text-align: left">The Endpoints, two replicas</td>
      </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
<p>And cause each Client to get a vWire connecting it to one of the Endpoints. Network Service Mesh handles the
Network Service Discovery and Routing, as well as the vWire &lsquo;Connection Handling&rsquo; for setting all of this up.</p>
<a href="/extensions/adapters/nsm/images/icmp-responder-example-2.svg">
  <img style="width:500px; background: white" src="/extensions/adapters/nsm/images/icmp-responder-example-2.svg" />
</a>
<p>In order to make this case more interesting, Endpoint1 and Endpoint2 are deployed on two separate Nodes using
<em>PodAntiAffinity</em>, so that the Network Service Mesh has to demonstrate the ability to string vWires between Clients and
Endpoints on the same Node and Clients and Endpoints on different Nodes.</p>
<p>Verification</p>
<ol>
<li>Verify that the icmp-responder example Pods are all up and running:</li>
</ol>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock"><div class="clipboardjs">
 $ kubectl get pods | grep icmp-responder
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>To see the icmp-responder example in action, you may run:</li>
</ol>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock"><div class="clipboardjs">
 $ curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/networkservicemesh/networkservicemesh/master/scripts/nsc_ping_all.sh | bash
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<h3 id="suggested-topics">
	Suggested Topics
</h3>
<ul>
<li>Examine <a href="/v0.9/concepts/architecture/">Meshery&rsquo;s architecture</a> and how adapters fit in as a component.</li>
<li>Learn more about <a href="/v0.9/concepts/architecture/adapters/">Meshery Adapters</a>.</li>
</ul>
  
  






<h3>Lifecycle management</h3>

<p>The Meshery Adapter for Network Service Mesh can install <strong>v0.2.1</strong> of Network Service Mesh. A number of sample applications can be installed using the Meshery Adapter for Network Service Mesh.</p>












</article>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Meshery Adapter for Tanzu Service Mesh</h1>
          
          
<article>
<table style="display: flex; align-self: center; justify-self: center">
  <th>Cloud Native Infrastructure</th>
  <th>Adapter Status</th>
  <th>Adapter Version</th>
  <th>Earliest Supported Infrastructure Version</th>
  <tr>
    <td><img src="/extensions/adapters/tanzu-sm/images/tanzu.svg" style="width:20px" data-logo-for-dark="/extensions/adapters/tanzu-sm/images/tanzu.svg" data-logo-for-light="/extensions/adapters/tanzu-sm/images/tanzu.svg" class="logo-dark-light" loading="lazy"/> Tanzu Service Mesh</td>
    <td><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery-tanzu-sm">alpha</a></td>
    <td>v0.1.0</td>
    <td>pre-GA</td>
  </tr>
</table>

  <h3 id="suggested-reading">
	Suggested Reading
</h3>
<ul>
<li>Examine <a href="/v0.9/concepts/architecture/">Meshery&rsquo;s architecture</a> and how adapters fit in as a component.</li>
<li>Learn more about <a href="/v0.9/concepts/architecture/adapters/">Meshery Adapters</a>.</li>
</ul>
  
  






<h3>Lifecycle management</h3>

<p>The Meshery Adapter for Tanzu Service Mesh can install <strong>pre-GA</strong> of Tanzu Service Mesh. A number of sample applications can be installed using the Meshery Adapter for Tanzu Service Mesh.</p>


  <p>The Meshery Adapter for Tanzu Service Mesh is currently under construction (alpha state), which means that the adapter is not fully functional. Want to contribute? Check our <a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery-tanzu-sm">progress</a>.</p>











</article>

    $(document).ready(function () {

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {

            });

            <h1>Meshery Adapter for Traefik Mesh</h1>
          
          
<article>
<table style="display: flex; align-self: center; justify-self: center">
  <th>Cloud Native Infrastructure</th>
  <th>Adapter Status</th>
  <th>Adapter Version</th>
  <th>Earliest Supported Infrastructure Version</th>
  <tr>
    <td><img src="/extensions/adapters/traefik-mesh/images/traefik-mesh.svg" style="width:20px" data-logo-for-dark="/extensions/adapters/traefik-mesh/images/traefik-mesh.svg" data-logo-for-light="/extensions/adapters/traefik-mesh/images/traefik-mesh.svg" class="logo-dark-light" loading="lazy"/> Traefik Mesh</td>
    <td><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery-traefik-mesh">stable</a></td>
    <td>v0.6.9</td>
    <td>v1.0</td>
  </tr>
</table>

  <h3 id="sample-applications">
	Sample Applications
</h3>
<p>The Meshery Adapter for Traefik Mesh includes some sample applications operations. Meshery can be used to deploy any of these sample applications.</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/">Bookinfo</a></li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps/">Httpbin</a>
<ul>
<li>Httpbin is a simple HTTP request and response service.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="suggested-topics">
	Suggested Topics
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Examine <a href="/v0.9/concepts/architecture/">Meshery&rsquo;s architecture</a> and how adapters fit in as a component.</li>
<li>Learn more about <a href="/v0.9/concepts/architecture/adapters/">Meshery Adapters</a>.</li>
</ul>
  
  






<h3>Lifecycle management</h3>

<p>The Meshery Adapter for Traefik Mesh can install <strong>v1.0</strong> of Traefik Mesh. A number of sample applications can be installed using the Meshery Adapter for Traefik Mesh.</p>












</article>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="import-and-export-designs">
	Import and Export Designs
</h1>
<p>Meshery supports two primary operations for working with designs: <strong>Import</strong> and <strong>Export</strong>.
A <strong><a href="/v0.9/concepts/logical/designs/">design</a></strong> in Meshery is a structured model describing how various components (e.g., Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, or Docker Compose objects) should be managed and deployed. This document details the core concepts, the import/export processes, and the available methods to perform them.</p>
<h2 id="core-operations">
	Core Operations
</h2>
<p>Meshery treats each design as a combination of:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Components</strong>: Defined resources or services (e.g., Deployments, Services).</li>
<li><strong>Relationships</strong>: Possible connections or dependencies among components (e.g., hierarchical, sibling, edge).</li>
</ul>
<p>When <strong>importing</strong> a design, Meshery:</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Parses</strong> and <strong>validates</strong> the design file.</li>
<li>Processes design structure, applying transformations as needed.</li>
<li><strong>Routes</strong> validated components to the appropriate Meshery Adapters for further deployment or processing.</li>
</ol>
<p>When <strong>exporting</strong> a design, Meshery:</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Fetches</strong> the design data from the Meshery database using <code>/api/pattern/download/{id}</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Converts</strong> the design format if necessary (e.g., from V1alpha2 to V1beta1).</li>
<li><strong>Applies</strong> requested export format (e.g., <code>current</code>, <code>original</code>, <code>oci</code>, <code>helm-chart</code>).</li>
<li><strong>Sends</strong> the exported design file for download as a YAML file or OCI artifact or Helm chart(.tgz).</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="import-methods">
	Import Methods
</h2>
<p>You can import designs into Meshery through either <strong><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">Meshery CLI</a></strong> or <strong>Meshery UI</strong>.</p>
<h4 id="1-using-meshery-cli">
	1. Using Meshery CLI
</h4>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">mesheryctl design import --file &lt;PATH/URL&gt; --source-type &lt;TYPE&gt;
</span></span></code></pre></div><div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"># Example: Import Kubernetes manifest</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">mesheryctl design import -f ./app-deployment.yaml -s manifest
</span></span></code></pre></div><h4 id="2-using-meshery-ui">
	2. Using Meshery UI
</h4>
<ol>
<li>Go to <strong>Designs &gt; Import Design</strong>.</li>
<li>Choose your input method.</li>
<li>Select the source type from the dropdown (e.g., Kubernetes manifest, Helm chart).</li>
<li>Submit the design for processing.</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="import-processing-details">
	Import Processing Details
</h3>
<p>After you initiate an import, Meshery executes a <strong>dataflow sequence</strong> to properly handle the design:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Client submits a design</strong>
A POST request is sent to <code>/api/pattern/import</code>, containing a design file. If the design is sourced from Kubernetes Manifests, Docker Compose, or Helm Charts, it is first converted into a standard Kubernetes Manifest.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Pattern Engine queries registry</strong>
Meshery queries the component registry to match the design’s <code>kind</code>, <code>apiVersion</code>, and other identifiers. If the design originates from non-Meshery formats, Meshery attempts to transform it accordingly.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>System converts design format</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Converts Helm Charts, Docker Compose, and Kubernetes Manifests into Meshery Design.</li>
<li>Removes unnecessary fields and ensures compatibility.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Validated components are stored in Meshery</strong>
Once validated, the design is stored in Meshery. Users can later deploy it to a supported platform (e.g., Kubernetes, Consul, Istio) using Meshery UI or CLI.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="export-methods">
	Export Methods
</h2>
<p>Designs can also be exported either via <strong>Meshery CLI</strong> or <strong>Meshery UI</strong>. During export, Meshery gathers the design’s components, relationships, and metadata into a specified format.</p>
<h4 id="1-using-meshery-cli-1">
	1. Using Meshery CLI
</h4>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">mesheryctl design <span class="nb">export</span> --type &lt;FORMAT&gt; --output &lt;DIRECTORY&gt;
</span></span></code></pre></div><div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"># Example: Export to OCI format</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">mesheryctl design <span class="nb">export</span> --type oci -o ./exports
</span></span></code></pre></div><h4 id="2-using-meshery-ui-1">
	2. Using Meshery UI
</h4>
<ol>
<li>Go to <strong>Designs &gt; My Designs</strong> and select the design you want to export.</li>
<li>Click the <strong>Export</strong> action button.</li>
<li>Choose an export format (e.g., <code>current</code>, <code>original</code>, <code>oci</code>).</li>
<li>Specify the download location for your exported file.</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="summary">
	Summary
</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Import</strong>: Meshery parses and validates your design, converts non-Meshery formats (e.g., Kubernetes Manifests, Helm Charts, Docker Compose) into Meshery Designs, and stores the design in Meshery. Users can later deploy it to the correct adapters as needed.</li>
<li><strong>Export</strong>: Meshery <strong>retrieves</strong> the design from storage, <strong>converts</strong> its format if needed, <strong>packages</strong> it in the selected format (<code>current</code>, <code>original</code>, <code>oci</code>), and <strong>delivers</strong> it as a YAML file or OCI artifact via CLI or UI download.</li>
</ul>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>Extensions</h1>
          
          
<p>Extensions in Meshery are additional plugins or add-ons that provide extra functionalities beyond the core features of the platform. These extensions can be used to customize, extend and integrate with other tools and services.</p>



<ul class="section-title">

  
    
      <li style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 2px 0;">
        <a href="/v0.9/extensions/adapters/">Adapters</a>

        
          - Meshery architecture is extensible. Meshery provides several extension points for working with different cloud native infrastructure via adapters, load generators and providers.
        
      </li>
    
  
    
      <li style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 2px 0;">
        <a href="/v0.9/extensions/models/">Meshery Models</a>

        
          - Meshery architecture is extensible. Meshery provides several extension points for working with different cloud native projects via adapters, load generators and providers
        
      </li>
    
  

  
    
      <li style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 2px 0;">
        <a href="/v0.9/extensions/helm--snapshot/">Helm  Snapshot</a>

        
          - Helm CLI plugin to visually render a snapshot of your Helm charts.
        
      </li>
    
  
    
      <li style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 2px 0;">
        <a href="/v0.9/extensions/import-export-designs/">Import and Export Designs</a>

        
          - Manage and transfer Meshery designs seamlessly through import and export using CLI and UI.
        
      </li>
    
  
    
      <li style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 2px 0;">
        <a href="/v0.9/extensions//"></a>

        
          - Collaborative cloud native visual designer to design and manage infrastructure and applications.
        
      </li>
    
  
    
      <li style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 2px 0;">
        <a href="/v0.9/extensions/-snapshot/"> Snapshot</a>

        
          - Screenshot service provided via  to capture a snapshot of your infrastructure at any given time.
        
      </li>
    
  
    
      <li style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 2px 0;">
        <a href="/v0.9/extensions/kubectl-meshsync-snapshot/">kubectl MeshSync Snapshot</a>

        
          - A native kubectl plugin for conveniently synchronizing the state of your cluster with Meshery Server.
        
      </li>
    
  

</ul>




        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <item>
      <title>Helm  Snapshot</title>
      <link>/v0.9/extensions/helm--snapshot/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/extensions/helm--snapshot/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;helm--snapshot&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;&lt;img style=&#34;height: 4rem; width: 4rem;&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/extensions/images/helm-chart-color.svg&#34; /&gt; Helm  Snapshot&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;extension-overview&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Extension Overview&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;The &lt;strong&gt; Snapshot Helm Plugin&lt;/strong&gt; allows users to generate a visual snapshot of their Helm charts directly from the command line. It simplifies the process of creating Meshery Snapshots, providing a visual representation of packaged Helm charts. This plugin integrates with Meshery Cloud and GitHub Actions to automate the workflow of snapshot creation, which is especially useful for Helm users who need to quickly visualize their chart configurations.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Import and Export Designs</title>
      <link>/v0.9/extensions/import-export-designs/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/extensions/import-export-designs/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;import-and-export-designs&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Import and Export Designs&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Meshery supports two primary operations for working with designs: &lt;strong&gt;Import&lt;/strong&gt; and &lt;strong&gt;Export&lt;/strong&gt;.&#xA;A &lt;strong&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/concepts/logical/designs/&#34;&gt;design&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/strong&gt; in Meshery is a structured model describing how various components (e.g., Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, or Docker Compose objects) should be managed and deployed. This document details the core concepts, the import/export processes, and the available methods to perform them.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;core-operations&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Core Operations&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Meshery treats each design as a combination of:&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title></title>
      <link>/v0.9/extensions//</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/extensions//</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;-beta&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;&lt;img style=&#34;height: 4rem; width: 4rem;&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/extensions/images/-icon-color.svg&#34; /&gt;  &lt;sup style=&#34;font-size: 1.8rem; vertical-align: top;&#34;&gt;BETA&lt;/sup&gt;&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt; is a GitOps-infused cloud native &lt;b&gt;visual designer&lt;/b&gt; for Kubernetes and cloud native applications.  works with your Kubernetes clusters so that you design and manage your infrastructure and applications between members of your team.  has two modes: Designer and Visualizer. Create and share your own Kubernetes deployments and patterns in  Designer. Deploy your designs and manage your infrastructure using  Visualizer. It includes multi-user collaboration features that allow teams to work together seamlessly towards achieving their goals in a more timely manner.  aims at removing all the challenging aspects of collaboration from the equation so that everyone on your team can be on the same page when it comes to managing cloud-native infrastructure projects.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title> Snapshot</title>
      <link>/v0.9/extensions/-snapshot/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/extensions/-snapshot/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;-snapshot&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;&lt;img style=&#34;height: 4rem; width: 4rem;&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/extensions/images/-icon-color.svg&#34; /&gt;  Snapshot&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt; Snapshot is a screenshot service provided via  for your designs. Visualize changes to your code-base with each pull request made. The SnapShot GitHub Action is configurable from within your Cloud account.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;details&gt;&#xA;&lt;summary&gt;How the SnapShot service works&lt;/summary&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3&gt;Functional Sequence Diagram&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;img src=&#34;/v0.9/extensions/images/-snapshot.png&#34; /&gt;&#xA;&lt;/details&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3&gt;Installing  Snapshot: Github Pull Request&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Connect MeshMap to your GitHub repo and see changes pull request-to-pull request. Get snapshots of your infrastructure directly in your PRs.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>kubectl MeshSync Snapshot</title>
      <link>/v0.9/extensions/kubectl-meshsync-snapshot/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/extensions/kubectl-meshsync-snapshot/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;kubectl-meshsync-snapshot&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;&lt;img style=&#34;height: 4rem; width: 4rem;&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/extensions/images/meshsync.svg&#34; /&gt; kubectl MeshSync Snapshot&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;A &lt;code&gt;kubectl&lt;/code&gt; plugin for performing an ad hoc collection of resource information from a Kubernetes cluster and sending the cluster resources details to a Meshery Server. &lt;code&gt;kubectl meshsync snapshot&lt;/code&gt; is a native kubectl plugin for conveniently synchronizing the state of your cluster with Meshery Server.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;hr /&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;about-meshery-extensions&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;About Meshery Extensions&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;https://meshery.io/extensions&#34;&gt;Meshery Extensions&lt;/a&gt; are plugins or add-ons that enhance the functionality of the Meshery platform beyond its core capabilities. Meshery supports different types of extensions (&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/extensions/&#34;&gt;docs&lt;/a&gt;):&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
  </channel>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="kubectl-meshsync-snapshot">
	<img style="height: 4rem; width: 4rem;" src="/extensions/images/meshsync.svg" /> kubectl MeshSync Snapshot
</h1>
<p>A <code>kubectl</code> plugin for performing an ad hoc collection of resource information from a Kubernetes cluster and sending the cluster resources details to a Meshery Server. <code>kubectl meshsync snapshot</code> is a native kubectl plugin for conveniently synchronizing the state of your cluster with Meshery Server.</p>
<hr />
<h2 id="about-meshery-extensions">
	About Meshery Extensions
</h2>
<p><a href="https://meshery.io/extensions">Meshery Extensions</a> are plugins or add-ons that enhance the functionality of the Meshery platform beyond its core capabilities. Meshery supports different types of extensions (<a href="/v0.9/extensions/">docs</a>):</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/v0.9/concepts/architecture/adapters/">Adapters</a>: Adapters allow Meshery to interface with the different cloud native infrastructure.</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/extensibility/load-generators/">Load Generators</a>: for performance characterization and benchmarking</li>
<li><a href="/extensibility/integrations">Integrations</a>: model-based support for a broad variety of design and orchestration of cloud and cloud native platforms, tools, and technologies.</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/extensibility/providers/">Providers</a>: for connecting to different cloud providers and infrastructure platforms</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/extensibility/ui/">UI Plugins</a>: Meshery UI has a number of extension points that allow users to customize their experience with third-party plugins.</li>
</ul>

        </div>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<article>

    <h2>What are Meshery Models and Components?</h2>

<p>Meshery Models and Components represent the fundamental building blocks of your infrastructure. Use them to define the structure and configuration of your infrastructure and deployments by incorporating their use into a Design. Think of Designs as blueprints or templates that encapsulate everything from network configurations to service definitions.</p>

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about <a href="/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>, <a href="/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>, and <a href="/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a></h6>

    <h2>What is the Meshery Registry</h2>

The Meshery Registry is a vital component within Meshery, serving as a centralized repository for managing a diverse range of cloud and cloud native resources. It stores and organizes crucial information such as models, categories, components, and relationships, enabling efficient interaction and utilization of these resources within the Meshery ecosystem. You can conveniently access and manage registry data through Meshery UI, and through Meshery CLI (<a href="/reference/mesheryctl/registry">mesheryctl registry</a>).

<h6 class="integration">Learn more about the <a href="/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a></h6>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
